synopsis: MORAI is a commercial, complete or near-complete digital-twin driving simulation platform with scenario libraries and cloud execution, including large-scale cloud simulation [f8510, f8350, f8369, f9034]. It simulates camera, lidar, radar, GPS and IMU sensors, supports OpenSCENARIO 1.x, and is also listed among tools supporting OpenDRIVE [f8511, f8512, f8616]. Reported projects span automotive, trucking, Seoul digital twins, and unmanned ground and defense work, but the corpus found no off-road or mining/construction use evidence and no deformable-terrain support evidence [f8513, f15912, f8514, f8515]. MORAI requires supplier contact for pricing; neither platform pricing nor public large-scale cloud pricing was found, with the cloud comparison citing sources dated 2024–2026 [f15911, f8517, f9038, f9256]. No numbered or latest release was found, and the booklet cautions that vendor-cloud off-road relevance follows the underlying platform, leaving MORAI's suitability for heavy off-road validation unresolved [f8516, f9039, f9255, f9035].
